# Exploratory analysis

Goals

- Identify the best threshold to remove noise; improve quantitative predictions from ML

- plotting distributions

```{r loadStuff}
library(tidyverse)

# import data
base_path <- "archive/3R5library_madison/"
data <- read_tsv(str_c(base_path, "variant_data_parsed.tsv"))

summarise(data, count = n(), .by = Nham_nt) |> print()
cat("total rows in data: ", nrow(data), "\n")
```
